# Conscious Systems Bali

> Conscious Systems is Mark Tulloch's clarity practice in Kerobokan, Bali, and part of Lumindra (https://lumindra.co/). It offers a single Clarity Mapping Session, a 5-Session Journey (Awareness, Intention, Action, Reflection, Presence), Strategic Soul Consulting for founders and leaders, and The Captain's Map for parents of children aged 13 and over. Sessions run one-to-one or in a small group, in person in Bali or online. Prices are in Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) and confirmed on WhatsApp before anything is booked.

## Key facts
- Founder: Mark Tulloch, 35+ years running high-pressure hospitality across the UK, Australia and Bali; trained crisis counsellor, mental-health advocate, public speaker and author
- Location: Kerobokan, Bali, Indonesia. Online sessions worldwide
- Contact: WhatsApp +62 821 4402 9645 | connect@baliaiconsultant.com
- Not therapy, psychological assessment or medical advice

## Offers and prices (IDR)
- Clarity Mapping Session (one session): IDR 750k to 1.5jt. Produces a seven-part Clarity Map (Situation, Story, Emotions, Pattern, Choice, Path Forward, Final Truth) and a 30-Day Reset Plan
- The 5-Session Journey (five sessions, weekly or fortnightly): IDR 5jt to 8jt
- Strategic Soul Consulting (scoped together, for founders, operators and leaders): IDR 10jt+
- The Captain's Map, Identity Anchor session (one hour, for parents of children 13+): IDR 5,000,000 one-time. Includes an Operating Map PDF within 48 hours, a System Profile, a Parental Leadership Script and 14-day WhatsApp follow-up. Maximum six families per month
